inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL locale-data upsert uses one COALESCE(NULLIF(existing,''), NULLIF(VALUES(incoming),''), '') expression per duplicate-key column so nonblank existing text wins, blank incoming text cannot erase it, and empty new values fall back to an empty string.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a release-localization registry. A multi-row upsert fills nonblank title and objective patches, preserves existing descriptions and completion text when incoming values are blank, leaves an all-blank duplicate unchanged, and inserts a new locale row. The source schema, identifiers, text, and game domain are not copied.

fixture_notes: Locale row 7001 updates its nonblank title and objective while preserving existing details and completed text; row 7002 receives an all-blank duplicate and remains unchanged; row 7003 is inserted with a complete translation.
determinism_notes: Fixed locale IDs, text values, duplicate-key rows, empty-string fallback, and final ordering are used; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE release_locales (locale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, locale_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, details VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, objective VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, completed_text VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO release_locales VALUES (7001, 'fr-FR', 'Ancien titre', 'Description conservee', 'Objectif ancien', 'Texte final conserve'), (7002, 'de-DE', 'Titel bleibt', 'Details bleiben', 'Ziel bleibt', 'Abschluss bleibt')

steps.sql: INSERT INTO release_locales (locale_id, locale_code, title, details, objective, completed_text) VALUES (7001, 'fr-FR', 'Nouveau titre', '', 'Nouvel objectif', ''), (7002, 'de-DE', '', '', '', ''), (7003, 'es-ES', 'Titulo nuevo', 'Descripcion nueva', 'Objetivo nuevo', 'Texto final nuevo') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = COALESCE(NULLIF(title, ''), NULLIF(VALUES(title), ''), ''), details = COALESCE(NULLIF(details, ''), NULLIF(VALUES(details), ''), ''), objective = COALESCE(NULLIF(objective, ''), NULLIF(VALUES(objective), ''), ''), completed_text = COALESCE(NULLIF(completed_text, ''), NULLIF(VALUES(completed_text), ''), '')
SELECT locale_id, locale_code, title, details, objective, completed_text FROM release_locales ORDER BY locale_id
